en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is consciousness (*citta*), a state that is neither consciousness nor wholesome arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... Three [answers] for root; ...pe... three for non-disappearance (*avigata*).
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is consciousness, a state that is neither consciousness nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition... Three for root; ...pe... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is not consciousness, a state that is neither not-consciousness nor indeterminate arises by way of root condition... Three for root; ...pe... three for non-disappearance.
